summary: The etude fdlock cases with faults in namespace locking, orphan truncation and shared raw offsets

argv: make -s rach2 tests krffs build/tests/host/fd_hosttest build/tests/system/mkfixture build/tests/system/harness ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/rach2/kernel ${WORK}/kernel
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run fdlock "run: fdlock: PASS"

faults.name: namespace
faults.summary: operations on a description of a file system whose namespace is serialised made without the namespace lock

faults.name: raw-read
faults.summary: a raw device's read made without the shared offset held

lines: concurrent raw reader consumes second sector

faults.name: raw-write
faults.summary: a raw device's write made without the shared offset held

lines: raw shared offset retains both operations

faults.name: lseek
faults.summary: a raw device's lseek made without the descriptor lock

lines: raw lseek waits for transfer offset

faults.name: llseek
faults.summary: a raw device's _llseek made without the descriptor lock

lines: raw llseek waits for transfer offset

faults.name: orphan
faults.summary: a KRFFS file truncated by the path an unlinked file no longer has

faults.name: readv
faults.summary: a ready device read through the device's own read and not read_ops

lines: raw readv reserves its second sector
